description:
## Main responsibilities

Enterprise & Strategic Transformation

- Drive bank-wide transformation initiatives aligned with the long-term strategy of EFG

- Translate strategic priorities (growth, efficiency, client experience) into concrete transformation roadmaps.

- Support Executive Committee members in strategy execution and transformation governance.

- Prepare decision material for senior management and Board-level discussions

Operating Model & Process Excellence

- Design and implement target operating models adapted to a relationship-driven private banking environment.

- Support optimization of front-to-back processes across:
-  Client Relationship Management and Client Advisory

-  Investment Services and Portfolio Management

-  Operations and Middle Office

- Lead cost-efficiency and productivity initiatives while preserving service quality and client experience

Digital & Data Transformation

- Lead business-driven digital initiatives including:
-  CRM and client lifecycle management

-  Advisory and portfolio management tools

-  Process automation (workflow digitization, RPA, AI use cases)

- Act as bridge between business, IT, and data teams to ensure adoption and value realization.

- Promote data-driven management through dashboards, KPIs, and management information.

Regulatory & Risk-Driven Change

- Manage transformation initiatives related to FINMA regulation, AML/KYC, suitability, cross-border rules.

- Ensure regulatory changes are embedded pragmatically into business processes.

- Work closely with Compliance, Risk, Legal, and Internal Audit.

Change Management & Stakeholder Engagement

- Act as an internal change leader and sparring partner for senior executives and department heads.

- Drive change management: communication, training, and adoption across the organization.

- Manage resistance to change in a traditional private banking culture.

Program & Delivery Management

- Own end-to-end delivery of transformation initiatives:
-  Governance, milestones, KPIs, and benefits realization

-  Budget and resource management

-  Risk, dependency, and issue management

- Coordinate internal teams and selectively manage external consultants and vendors.

## Skills and experience

- Pure Private Banking Expertise, with hands-on understanding of:
- Relationship-based private banking business model

- Investment products and services

- UHNW/HNW client expectations

- Strong sensitivity to confidentiality, risk culture, and reputational consideration

- Transformation & Execution
- Enterprise and functional transformation

- Operating model design

- Business case development and benefits tracking

- Program and portfolio management

- Digital & Analytical Skills
- Ability to translate technology into business value

- CRM platforms, Front office / Investment applications and private banking core systems

- Process automation and digitalisation / AI in banking

- Data analytics and performance management

- Leadership & Personal Skills
- Executive-level communication and presentation skills

- Strong influencing skills without formal authority

- Structured problem-solving and analytical rigor

- High discretion, resilience, and ownership mindset

- Strong cultural fit with Swiss private banking values

- Experience & Background
- Background / profile : Chief of Staff, Internal transformation, COO Office, or strategy roles within private banks and/or top-tier strategy/management consulting

- 10–15 years of professional experience

- Proven track record delivering in-house transformation initiatives

- Strong exposure to Swiss private banking market and regulatory environment

- International experience considered an asset

- Education
- MBA from a leading business school

- Master’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, or equivalent

- Languages
- Fluent English (mandatory)

- French and/or German (strongly preferred)

## Our Values

- Accountability: Taking ownership for tasks and challenges, as well as seeking continuous improvement

- Hands-on: Being proactive to rapidly deliver high-quality results

- Passionate: Being committed and striving for excellence

- Solution-driven: Focusing on client outcomes and treating clients fairly with a risk-aware mindset

- Partnership-oriented: Promoting collaboration and teamwork. Working together with an entrepreneurial spirit.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Principali responsabilità

Impresa e trasformazione strategica
- Guidare iniziative di trasformazione bancarie allineate con la strategia a lungo termine di EFG
- Tradurre priorità strategiche (crescita, efficienza, esperienza cliente) in roadmap di trasformazione concreta.
- Sostenere i membri del Comitato Esecutivo nell'esecuzione della strategia e nella governance della trasformazione.
- Preparare materiale decisionale per la gestione senior e discussioni a livello di Consiglio

Modello operativo & Eccellenza di processo
- Progettare e implementare modelli operativi mirati adattati a un ambiente di private banking legato.
- Supporto ottimizzazione dei processi front-to-back attraverso:
- Gestione delle relazioni cliente e Consulenza clienti
- Servizi di investimento e Gestione Portfolio
- Operazioni e Ufficio Centrale
- Guidare le iniziative di efficienza e produttività dei costi, preservando al contempo la qualità dei servizi e l'esperienza dei clienti

Trasformazione digitale e dati
- Lead business-driven iniziative digitali tra cui:
- CRM e gestione del ciclo di vita del cliente
- Strumenti di gestione del portafoglio e di consulenza
- Automazione del processo (di digitalizzazione del flusso di lavoro, RPA, casi di utilizzo AI)
- Agire come ponte tra business, IT e team di dati per garantire l'adozione e la realizzazione del valore.
- Promuovere la gestione dei dati attraverso dashboard, KPI e informazioni di gestione.

Regolazione & Risk-Driven Change
- Gestire iniziative di trasformazione relative alla regolamentazione FINMA, AML/KYC, idoneità, regole transfrontaliere.
- Assicurarsi che i cambiamenti normativi siano incorporati pragmaticamente nei processi aziendali.
- Lavorare a stretto contatto con Compliance, Rischio, Legale e Internal Audit.

Gestione delle modifiche & Stakeholder Engagement
- Agire come leader di cambiamento interno e partner di sparring per dirigenti senior e capi di reparto.
- Gestione del cambiamento di unità: comunicazione, formazione e adozione in tutta l'organizzazione.
- Gestire la resistenza al cambiamento in una cultura bancaria privata tradizionale.

Gestione del programma e della consegna
- Consegna immediata di iniziative di trasformazione:
- Governance, pietre miliari, KPI e realizzazione dei benefici
- Gestione del bilancio e delle risorse
- Rischio, dipendenza e gestione dei problemi
- Coordinare i team interni e gestire selettivamente consulenti e fornitori esterni.

Competenze ed esperienza
- Pure Private Banking Expertise, con la comprensione pratica di:
- Modello di business private banking basato sulle relazioni
- Prodotti e servizi di investimento
- UHNW/HNW aspettative dei clienti
- Forte sensibilità alla riservatezza, alla cultura del rischio e alla considerazione reputazionale
- Trasformazione e esecuzione
- Impresa e trasformazione funzionale
- Progettazione del modello operativo
- Sviluppo dei casi aziendali e monitoraggio dei benefici
- Gestione del programma e del portafoglio
- Abilità digitali e analitiche
- Capacità di tradurre la tecnologia in valore aziendale
- Piattaforme CRM, applicazioni front office / Investimenti e sistemi core bancari privati
- Automazione dei processi e digitalizzazione / AI nel settore bancario
- Analisi dei dati e gestione delle prestazioni
- Leadership e competenze personali
- Capacità di comunicazione e presentazione a livello esecutivo
- Forte influenzabilità senza autorità formale
- Rigor strutturato di problem solving e analitico
- Elevata discrezione, resilienza e mentalità di proprietà
- Forte vestibilità culturale con valori bancari privati svizzeri
- Esperienza e sfondo
- Sfondo / profilo: Capo di Stato Maggiore, Trasformazione interna, Ufficio COO, o ruoli strategici all'interno di banche private e/o di massima strategia/consulenza di gestione

- 10-15 anni di esperienza professionale
- Provato track record con iniziative di trasformazione interna
- Forte esposizione al mercato bancario privato svizzero e all'ambiente normativo
- Esperienza internazionale considerata un bene
- Istruzione
- MBA da una scuola di business leader
- Master in Business, Finanza, Economia, Ingegneria o equivalente
- Lingue
- Inglese fluente (obbligatorio)
- Francese e/o tedesco (fortemente preferito)

I nostri valori
- Responsabilità: Prendere la proprietà per i compiti e le sfide, nonché cercare un miglioramento continuo
- Hands-on: essere proattivi per fornire rapidamente risultati di alta qualità
- Passionato: Impegnarsi e lottare per l'eccellenza
- Soluzione-driven: Concentrarsi sui risultati del cliente e trattare i clienti in modo corretto con una mentalità di rischio-consapevole
- Partnership-oriented: promuovere la collaborazione e il lavoro di squadra. Lavorare insieme a uno spirito imprenditoriale.

Hauptverantwortlichkeiten Enterprise & Strategic Transformation
- Führen Sie bankweite Transformationsinitiativen aus, die mit der langfristigen Strategie von EFG
- Übersetzen Sie strategische Prioritäten (Wachstum, Effizienz, Kundenerfahrung) in konkrete Transformations-Roadmaps.
- Unterstützung der Mitglieder des Exekutivkomitees bei der Umsetzung der Strategie und der Governance der Transformation.
- Bereiten Sie Entscheidungsmaterial für Senior-Management- und Board-Level-Diskussionen vor Operating Model & Process Excellence
- Gestalten und implementieren Sie Ziel-Betriebsmodelle, die an ein verhältnisorientiertes Private-Banking-Umfeld angepasst sind.
- Optimierung von Vor-zu-Back-Prozessen über:
- Client Relationship Management und Client Advisory
- Investment Services and Portfolio Management
- Operations and Middle Office
- Führen Sie Kosteneffizienz- und Produktivitätsinitiativen während der Wartung von Service-Qualität und Kundenerfahrung Digital & Data Transformation
- Führen Sie unternehmensgetriebene digitale Initiativen einschließlich:
- CRM und Customer Lifecycle Management
- Beratungs- und Portfolio-Management-Tools
- Prozessautomatisierung (Workflow Digitalisierung, RPA, AI Use Cases)
- Datengesteuertes Management durch Dashboards, KPIs und Managementinformationen fördern. Regulatory & Risk-Driven Change
- Management-Transformationsinitiativen im Zusammenhang mit FINMA-Verordnung, AML/KYC, Eignung, grenzüberschreitende Regeln.
- Stellen Sie sicher, dass regulatorische Änderungen pragmatisch in Geschäftsprozesse eingebettet werden.
- Arbeiten Sie eng mit Compliance, Risk, Legal und Interne Audit. Change Management & Stakeholder Engagement
- Act als internes Change Leader und Sparring Partner für Führungskräfte und Abteilungsleiter.
- Steuerung der Änderung: Kommunikation, Schulung und Adoption in der gesamten Organisation.
- Verwalten Sie Widerstand gegen Veränderungen in einer traditionellen privaten Bankkultur. Program & Delivery Management
- Eigene End-to-End-Lieferung von Transformationsinitiativen:
- Governance, Meilensteine, KPIs und Vorteile Realisierung
- Budget- und Ressourcenmanagement
- Risiko, Abhängigkeit und Emissionsmanagement
- Koordinierte interne Teams und leiten selektiv externe Berater und Anbieter. Kompetenz und Erfahrung
- Pure Private Banking Expertise, mit praktischem Verständnis von:
- Relationship-based Private Banking Business Model
- Investment Produkte und Dienstleistungen
- UHNW/HNW-Client-Erwartungen
- Starke Sensibilität für Vertraulichkeit, Risikokultur und Reputation Zusammenarbeit mit einem Unternehmergeist.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Principales responsabilités Enterprise & Strategic Transformation
- Diriger les initiatives de transformation à l'échelle de la banque alignées sur la stratégie à long terme de l'EFG
- Traduire les priorités stratégiques (croissance, efficacité, expérience client) en feuilles de route de transformation concrètes.
- Soutenir les membres du Comité exécutif dans l'exécution de la stratégie et la gouvernance de la transformation.
- Préparer des documents décisionnels pour les cadres supérieurs et les discussions au niveau du conseil d'administration Modèle opérationnel et excellence des processus
- Concevoir et mettre en oeuvre des modèles opérationnels cibles adaptés à un environnement bancaire privé axé sur les relations.
- Soutenir l'optimisation des processus de pointe dans les domaines suivants :
- Gestion des relations avec la clientèle et conseils à la clientèle
- Services d'investissement et gestion de portefeuille
- Opérations et bureau intermédiaire
- Principales initiatives en matière de rentabilité et de productivité tout en préservant la qualité du service et l'expérience client Transformation numérique et des données
- Principales initiatives numériques axées sur l'entreprise, y compris :
- Gestion du cycle de vie de la clientèle
- Outils de conseil et de gestion de portefeuille
- Automatisation des processus (numérisation des flux de travail, APR, cas d'utilisation de l'IA)
- Agir comme un pont entre les équipes d'affaires, de TI et de données pour assurer l'adoption et la valorisation.
- Promouvoir la gestion axée sur les données au moyen de tableaux de bord, d'IPK et d'information de gestion. Changement réglementaire et axé sur le risque
- Gérer les initiatives de transformation liées à la réglementation FINMA, AML/KYC, la pertinence, les règles transfrontalières.
- Veiller à ce que les changements réglementaires soient intégrés de façon pragmatique dans les processus opérationnels.
- Travailler en étroite collaboration avec la conformité, le risque, la vérification juridique et interne. Gestion du changement et engagement des intervenants
- Agir à titre de chef de file du changement interne et de partenaire principal pour les cadres supérieurs et les chefs de département.
- Favoriser la gestion du changement : communication, formation et adoption dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.
- Gérer la résistance au changement dans une culture bancaire privée traditionnelle. Gestion des programmes et de l'exécution
- Exécution de bout en bout des initiatives de transformation :
- Gouvernance, jalons, ICR et réalisation des avantages
- Gestion du budget et des ressources
- Gestion des risques, de la dépendance et des enjeux
- Coordonner les équipes internes et gérer sélectivement les consultants et les fournisseurs externes. Compétences et expérience
- Pure Private Banking Expertise, avec une compréhension pratique de:
- Modèle d'entreprise de banque privée basé sur les relations
- Produits et services d'investissement
- Attentes des clients de l'UHNW/HNW
- Forte sensibilité à la confidentialité, à la culture des risques et à la considération de la réputation
- Transformation et exécution
- Transformation d'entreprise et transformation fonctionnelle
- Conception de modèle d'exploitation
- Développement de cas d'affaires et suivi des avantages
- Gestion de programmes et de portefeuilles
- Compétences numériques et analytiques
- Capacité de traduire la technologie en valeur opérationnelle
- Plates-formes CRM, Front office / Applications d'investissement et systèmes de base de banque privée
- Automatisation et numérisation des processus
- IA dans le secteur bancaire
- Analyse des données et gestion des performances
- Leadership et compétences personnelles
- Compétences de communication et de présentation
- Fortes compétences d'influence sans autorité formelle
- Résolution de problèmes structurés et rigueur analytique
- Grande discrétion, résilience et esprit de propriété
- Forte adéquation culturelle avec les valeurs de la banque privée suisse
- Expérience et contexte
- Forte exposition aux clients de la transformation interne, au bureau de l'entreprise ou aux rôles stratégiques au sein Travailler ensemble avec un esprit d'entreprise.

sections.heading: Our Company
paragraphs:
EFG International is a global private banking group, offering private banking and asset management services. We serve clients in over 40 locations worldwide. EFG International offers a stimulating and dynamic work environment and strives to be an employer of choice.
EFG is committed to providing an equitable and inclusive working environment that is founded on the principle of mutual respect. Joining our team means experiencing a supportive environment, where your contributions are valued and recognised. We strongly believe that the diversity of our teams gives us a competitive advantage by fostering better decision-making and greater innovation.
Empowering entrepreneurial minds to create value – today and for the future.

We are a private bank, offering personalised solutions on a global scale to private and institutional clients. Our sustainable success is based on our talents and on how we partner with our clients and communities to create lasting value.

We are looking to onboard a manager with 10–15 years of experience within private banking and wealth management institutions. The objective is for them to join the Transformation Office as a Senior member and to drive strategic, operational, and digital transformation initiatives tailored to the specific culture, risk profile, and client-centric model EFG. MBA-qualified would be a plus, with strong execution capabilities and deep understanding of front-to-back private banking operations.
